title: SBI AMC Investor Education & Statement Help
content: SBI Mutual Fund Statement Download and Service Help. To download your SBI Mutual Fund Account Statement or Capital Gains Report, follow these steps: Step 1: Visit the official SBI Mutual Fund portal (https://www.sbimf.com) and navigate to the 'Quick Links' section. Step 2: Click on 'Statement of Account' or 'Capital Gains Statement'. Step 3: Enter your registered Email ID, PAN number, or Folio Number. Step 4: Enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile number or email address. Step 5: Select the financial year or custom date range and download the statement PDF. For tax purposes, capital gains reports are last updated up to the current assessment year.

title: SBI AMC Capital Gains Taxation Guide
content: SBI Mutual Fund Capital Gains Taxation Guide. Taxation rules for SBI Mutual Fund schemes depend on the asset class: 1. Equity Mutual Funds (e.g., SBI Bluechip, SBI Small Cap, SBI Contra, SBI Focused Equity, SBI Long Term Equity): - Short-term Capital Gains (STCG): If units are redeemed within 1 year, gains are taxed at 15%. - Long-term Capital Gains (LTCG): If units are redeemed after 1 year, gains exceeding ₹1 Lakh in a financial year are taxed at 10% without indexation. 2. Debt Mutual Funds (e.g., SBI Magnum Constant Maturity Fund): - For investments made on or after April 1, 2023, all capital gains are treated as short-term and taxed at the investor's applicable income tax slab rate. Last updated from sources: May 2026.

title: SEBI Mutual Fund Categorization Guidelines FAQ
content: SEBI Mutual Fund Categorization Guidelines and Riskometer FAQ. SEBI guidelines specify the classification of mutual funds into 5 broad groups: Equity, Debt, Hybrid, Solution-Oriented, and Other schemes. - Riskometer: The Riskometer must have six risk levels: Low, Low to Moderate, Moderate, Moderately High, High, and Very High. It must be evaluated monthly based on portfolio characteristics. - ELSS: Equity Linked Savings Scheme must invest at least 80% in equities and carry a mandatory 3-year lock-in period. Last updated from sources: January 2021.

title: AMFI Mutual Fund Category Explanations
content: AMFI Mutual Fund Category Explanations. Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) Knowledge Center: - Equity Schemes: Invest primarily in shares/stocks. Capped categories include Large Cap (top 100 stocks), Mid Cap (101-250th stocks), and Small Cap (251st and below). - Debt Schemes: Invest in fixed income securities (treasury bills, government bonds, commercial paper). - ELSS: A category of equity funds offering tax saving under Sec 80C with a 3-year lock-in. Last updated from sources: May 2026.

title: AMFI Total Expense Ratio (TER) Rules
content: AMFI Total Expense Ratio (TER) Rules. The Total Expense Ratio (TER) represents the annual operating expenses of a mutual fund scheme, expressed as a percentage of the fund's daily net assets. - Capped limits: Under SEBI Regulation 52, the maximum TER limit for equity schemes is 2.25% for the first ₹500 Crores of AUM, scaling down as AUM increases. - Regular vs Direct: Direct plans have a lower expense ratio since they do not include advisor commission or distribution costs. Last updated from sources: May 2026.

title: AMFI Exit Load Rules
content: AMFI Exit Load Rules. An exit load is a fee charged to investors when they redeem or switch out of a mutual fund scheme within a specified timeframe. - Purpose: To discourage short-term trading and protect long-term investors. - Calculation: Calculated as a percentage of the Net Asset Value (NAV) at redemption. For SBI equity funds, the standard exit load is 1% if redeemed within 1 year, and Nil thereafter. Last updated from sources: May 2026.

title: SEBI Directory of Registered Investment Advisors
content: SEBI Registered Investment Advisors (RIA) Information. Under SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013, no person can provide investment advice unless registered with SEBI. - Disclaimer: Factual queries about scheme features do not constitute investment advice. - Directory: To get personalized investment advice, consult a SEBI Registered Investment Advisor. The directory of certified RIAs is available at https://www.sebi.gov.in. Last updated from sources: May 2026.
